5056095713122.baseName: True Products 10ft Pre-Lit Fraser Fir Artificial Christmas Tree - Warm White Lights
5056095713122.variantName: True Products 10ft Pre-Lit Fraser Fir Artificial Christmas Tree - Warm White Lights
5056095713122.sourceDescription:
Bring a welcoming glow to your home with our Pre-Lit Fraser Fir Christmas Tree. Combining realistic foliage with warm white LED lights, creates a timeless festive centrepiece for cosy evenings and Christmas celebrations.

This Fraser Fir has a traditional silhouette that suits everything from delicate neutral decorations to rich reds and golds. Its mixed tips combine realistic PE foliage with PVC tips to create a full, natural-looking backdrop for your favourite ornaments.

The lights are already fitted, leaving you free to enjoy decorating. Settle on a steady glow for a relaxed atmosphere, add a little twinkle or choose a gentle slow fade. With 8 multifunction settings, you can change the effect to suit the occasion. The lighting is mains powered through a low voltage transformer.

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, and the included folding metal stand provides a practical base. Gently spread the branches and arrange each tip to bring out the tree's full shape, then finish with treasured baubles and your chosen tree topper.

Features:
 Light functions: 8 settings, including steady glow, twinkle and slow fade
 Power supply: Mains powered with a low voltage transformer
 Realistic mixed PE and PVC foliage
 Traditional Christmas tree shape
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 For indoor use only

Take time to separate and shape the branches after assembly to achieve a full, balanced appearance.
Height: 10ft / 3m
Diameter: 196cm
Tip count: 3353 (1016 PE and 2337 PVC)
Lights: 1150 warm white LEDs
Guarantee - 1 year
Tool free assembly
With stand

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Material: Plastic. Product measurements: length 10 cm, width 10 cm, height 20 cm. Quantity: 5 pack.

Creates a festive focal point for Christmas displays.
Durable plastic construction for lasting decorative use.

Compact ground-insert design: This 2-piece Christmas tree set features a 60cm tree body with a 16cm ground stake, making it easy to insert into soil or garden beds. The compact 40 cm diameter adds festive charm to your garden, porch, or outdoor space.
Colourful constant glow: Each pre-lit Christmas tree features 60 colourful LED lights in a steady-on mode, creating a cheerful holiday atmosphere. Battery powered with 3 AA batteries per tree (not included), it requires no nearby power outlet for flexible outdoor decorating.

Convenient build and storage: This Christmas tree easily separates into manageable sections with a foldable metal base for simple space-saving storage. For a fuller visual profile, we highly recommend spending extra time in shaping. Need help shaping trees? Reach out to us for tips.
Outdoor christmas atmosphere: Designed for outdoor use, these pre-lit Christmas trees are suitable for gardens, patios, porches and yards, adding a warm and festive Christmas atmosphere to your outdoor space.

7984722962422.sourceDescription:
Celebrate Christmas with pastel macaron tones with this dreamy holiday tree.Boasting a soft pastel palette that departs from conventional deep green evergreens, this artificial fir offers whimsical romantic charm throughout your space. Loaded with 910 lush branch tips and vibrant PVC foliage, it forms a naturally full rounded silhouette; simply fluff the twigs to reveal rich dimensional texture. Pre-lit with 250 warm white LED bulbs and powered by a UKCA certified adapter, it casts steady soft illumination that highlights the pastel foliage and fills your space with immersive festive warmth. Featuring a 3 section hinged frame and folding metal stand, the tree sets up quickly, and included gloves protect your hands while shaping branches. Constructed from 100% new PVC material, this 6 ft tree maintains its beautiful appearance season after year, with flame-retardant, anti-fading, non-allergic and smell-free properties for worry-free indoor holiday decorating. Note: Ornaments are not included.

5056589156022.sourceDescription:
Christmas decorating doesn’t need to mean wrestling with branches, complicated sections and bulky storage boxes. This pop up Christmas tree provides a brilliantly simple way to bring festive style into your home, with a clever collapsible design that can be assembled and packed away with minimal effort.

Standing approximately 5ft tall, the tree is formed from green tinsel material to create a full, shimmering festive appearance. Simply position the central metal pole onto the sturdy plastic stand and allow the tree to drop into shape, giving you an eye-catching Christmas display without the lengthy set-up of a traditional artificial tree.
 
Its slim 35cm footprint makes it particularly useful where floor space is limited. Place it in a living room, hallway, dining area, bedroom or home office as part of your Christmas tree decorations and seasonal indoor decor. Once the festivities are finished, the pop up construction collapses back down into a compact size, making it much easier to store ready for next Christmas.

Suitable for indoor use only.

FESTIVE TINSEL FINISH: Covered in green tinsel material for a shimmering seasonal appearance that makes an attractive centrepiece for your Christmas tree decorations and indoor decor.
SPACE-SAVING DESIGN: Measuring approximately 150cm high with a footprint of just 35 x 35cm, this slim Christmas tree works particularly well in smaller rooms where floor area is limited.
STURDY SUPPORT: The lightweight decorative tree is supported by a central metal pole and sturdy plastic stand, helping provide a stable base once assembled and positioned indoors.
COMPACT AFTER CHRISTMAS: Once the festive season is finished, the pop up tree collapses down for convenient storage, taking up considerably less room than many conventional artificial Christmas trees.
Guarantee - 1 year

Ideal Sparkling Illumination: The Xmas tree is adorned with warm white lights, creating an enchanting holiday vibe. Meanwhile, its LED lights present better quality, proven by lower energy consumption, higher safety and a longer lifespan.
Realistic and Safe Decoration: Crafted with attention to detail, this Christmas tree replicates the beauty of a real tree, which is completed with vivid branch tips and lush mixed foliage. Plus, selected PE and PVC make it resist fire and deformations, while not causing allergies and having no weird smells.

5096042276522.baseName: No-sew Christmas wreath kit - 3D fabric craft set with cut-your-own sheets to make a festive door hanging - Red, green and cream
5096042276522.variantName: No-sew Christmas wreath kit - 3D fabric craft set with cut-your-own sheets to make a festive door hanging - Red, green and cream
5096042276522.sourceDescription:
Red, green and cream fabric sheets let you cut your own squares or circles before tucking them into the base. Aim for pieces about 8 to 10 cm across. You will need your own scissors, but the project requires no sewing machine.

Working with cloth gives you control over the fullness of the finished piece. Even within one colour, the depth of a tuck and the way a loose edge falls can change the surface, giving the wreath a finish that is individual to its maker. Try arranging a few pieces beside one another before tucking them into the base. Two similar shades produce a softer patch of colour, while a change from light to dark makes an edge or small motif stand out.

Unlike a flat printed hanging, the fabric surface has a profile of its own. Allow space in front of it when you choose a position and keep it clear of items that might press the folds flat as the door moves. A small fold changes the look of the cloth as it meets the base. Place each piece so that its outer edge remains visible and work across neighbouring areas in turn to keep the raised surface looking even.

The project lends itself to several short sessions in the run-up to Christmas. Keep the unfinished work flat with the remaining pieces grouped beside it so that it is easy to see where to begin next time. Work in short sections and look at the front of the piece from a little distance between stages.

To give the finished work as a present, choose a box deep enough to leave the decorated face clear of the lid. A handwritten gift tag can say who made it and when, a small detail that turns the project into a keepsake. Lay the finished piece face up when you put it away. A shallow box with enough room for the edges helps preserve the work and lets you bring it out again without first having to reshape the front.
Create a unique festive door hanging with this no-sew Christmas wreath kit featuring red, green and cream fabric.
Enjoy creative control over the finish by cutting your own squares or circles to tuck into the base for a personalised look.
This craft set includes uncut fabric sheets and requires only scissors, making it an accessible project for all skill levels.
The 3D fabric technique adds depth and profile to your decoration, creating a textured finish that stands out on any door.

5059574938122.sourceDescription:
Christmas Village
This Christmas village adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Battery Powered
Battery power gives flexibility over positioning without relying on a nearby mains socket during use. Fit the specified battery type and follow the supplied instructions.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Resin. Quantity: 1 set.
Battery powered for flexible positioning without needing a nearby mains socket.
Warm white light provides a soft, coordinated tone for festive displays.
Crafted from durable resin to add detailed character to your Christmas decor.
Single set design allows it to serve as a focal point in any seasonal arrangement.
Guarantee - 1 month
Power source: Battery-powered
Seasonal display decoration with warm white lighting
Comes with Batteries required (type not specified in source)

 The finished ornament works great as indoor hanging decoration, and it is also a thoughtful handmade gift for family and friends.

 Step-by-Step Instruction Book
 1 x Gift Box

Please Note

 Please follow the instruction booklet carefully when crocheting.

Featuring a decorative gold wire mesh design and integrated LED lighting, this stylish Christmas star creates an eye-catching seasonal accent that complements both modern and traditional Christmas decorations.

The convenient automatic timer makes everyday use simple, allowing you to enjoy its festive glow without having to remember to switch it on and off.

Whether you are adding a decorative finishing touch to your Christmas display, coordinating gold festive ornaments or searching for a thoughtful seasonal gift, this illuminated Christmas star offers a stylish way to bring extra sparkle to your home.
